principles.primaryQuestion: How favorable is the current investment environment relative to the selected historical period, what evidence is driving that assessment, and is that evidence strengthening or weakening?
principles.relativePosition: percentile within selected valid observation window

daily.description: 20 trading-day direction with 60 trading-day confirmation; one-day movement is not a trend

weekly.description: six weekly observations with roughly one-quarter confirmation

monthly.description: three successive releases define initial persistence; six releases provide stronger confirmation

quarterly.description: two successive quarters define direction; four quarters provide year-over-year context

inflationPressure.question: Is inflation pressure building, contained, or easing?
rules: High or rising realized inflation confirmed by rising energy/input prices and/or breakevens increases evidence that inflation pressure is building.
Three successive monthly increases in realized inflation are persistent evidence; confirmation from WTI or breakevens increases confidence.
Falling realized inflation with stable/falling expectations and energy prices supports Easing.
Divergence between realized inflation and input/expectation measures is Mixed rather than forced into a directional state.

financialConditions.question: Are policy, rates, credit and liquidity becoming more supportive or restrictive?
rules: NFCI and credit spreads are direct evidence of financial-condition tightness and receive greater interpretive priority than any single Treasury yield.
High/rising real yields and policy rates reinforce a Restrictive classification when credit conditions are also tightening.
A yield-curve move is contextual: inversion or re-steepening must be interpreted alongside growth and credit conditions rather than assigned a universal sign.
Broad easing across NFCI, credit spreads and real/policy rates supports Supportive or Improving conditions.

growthMomentum.question: Is economic activity expanding, stable, slowing, or contracting?
rules: Payrolls, industrial production, retail sales and real GDP describe realized growth conditions; market prices do not replace them.
Initial claims can provide earlier warning of labor deterioration and increase confidence in a Weakening classification when coincident data also slows.
QQQ/SPY are expectation/leadership context and should not dominate the historical growth assessment.
Broad improvement across multiple coincident indicators supports Improving/Strong; broad deterioration supports Weakening/Contracting.

marketRisk.question: How elevated is current market and credit stress relative to the selected period?
rules: Risk classification is driven primarily by volatility, credit stress and broad financial conditions relative to the selected historical window.
Gold is contextual and may reflect safe-haven demand, inflation hedging or real-rate effects; it must not receive a forced universal sign.
Multiple primary stress indicators rising together increases confidence in Elevated/High/Acute risk.
Falling VIX alone does not establish Low risk if credit spreads or NFCI remain stressed.

regimeRules.label: Favorable
regimeRules.when: Growth Momentum is Improving/Strong; Inflation Pressure is Easing/Contained; Financial Conditions are Supportive/Neutral; Market Risk is Low/Normal

regimeRules.label: Caution
regimeRules.when: Growth remains Stable/Improving/Strong while Inflation Pressure is Building/High & Persistent and/or Financial Conditions are Restrictive; Market Risk may be Normal/Elevated

regimeRules.label: Defensive
regimeRules.when: Growth Momentum is Weakening/Contracting while Inflation Pressure is Building/High & Persistent and Financial Conditions are Restrictive/Very Restrictive

regimeRules.label: Defensive
regimeRules.when: Growth Momentum is Weakening/Contracting with Market Risk High/Acute and/or materially restrictive financial conditions

regimeRules.label: Favorable — Improving
regimeRules.when: Growth Momentum turns Improving from weak levels while Inflation Pressure is Easing/Contained, Financial Conditions are becoming less restrictive, and Market Risk is falling

regimeRules.label: Neutral / Mixed
regimeRules.when: No other rule has sufficient confirmation or major signal families materially conflict
